items.title: 一度作れば，ゲーム開発はずっと続けていけるのか。創作，生存，持続をテーマにインディー開発者3名が本音で話すセッションをレポート［BIC2026］

zh.title: 一旦你创造了一个游戏，你能永远继续开发它吗？报道三位独立开发者诚实地谈论创造、生存和可持续发展主题的会议 [BIC2026]

en.title: Once you create a game, can you continue developing it forever? Report on a session where three indie developers spoke honestly on the themes of creation, survival, and sustainability [BIC2026]
en.summary: The core question is, once a game is developed, can it continue to be developed? Three groups of developers who started making games for different reasons took to the stage and answered questions solicited in advance from visitors in three sections: CREATE, SURVIVE, and CONTINUE.

items.title: 主人公は戦わない。「Ratopia」のCassel Gamesが次に作る「Ratocalypse」は，ゾンビだらけのネズミ王国で兵士の行動条件を設計するRPG［BIC2026］
items.summary: CasselGamesが開発中の「Ratocalypse」は，ネズミの兵士1体ずつにスキルを使う条件を決めておくと，自動で戦ってくれるストラテジーRPGだ。カードで街を守る「Ratropolis」，都市を作る「Ratopia」に続く，同スタジオ3本目のネズミゲーだ。「BIC2026」のブースで，開発者に話を聞いた。

zh.title: 主角不打架。 《Ratocalypse》是Cassel Games的《Ratopia》的下一款作品，是一款在充满僵尸的老鼠王国中设计士兵行为条件的角色扮演游戏[BIC2026]

en.title: The main character doesn't fight. "Ratocalypse", the next creation by Cassel Games of "Ratopia", is an RPG that designs the behavior conditions of soldiers in a rat kingdom full of zombies [BIC2026]
en.summary: ``Ratocalypse,'' currently being developed by CasselGames, is a strategy RPG that automatically fights by setting conditions for using skills on each rat soldier. This is the studio's third mouse game, following ``Ratropolis,'' where you protect a city with cards, and ``Ratopia,'' where you create a city. We spoke to the developer at the "BIC2026" booth.

items.summary: 【机事本】是机核文章区的栏目，每周五更新。每周五下班之前，我们会收集几位编辑的“小作文”，题材随意，立意自选，栏目名取自Windows系统自带的最轻便的文本编辑器，代表“轻便与畅快”。本周出场人物：雪豆，白广大，Samiii雪豆：玩《铁巢重炮》玩魔怔了我把自己关在数字的钢铁堡垒里，反复推演着一门并不存在的火炮轨迹。屏幕上的坐标网格如蛛网般精密，每一道刻度都在等待一个数字的献祭。鼠标滑过那些冰冷的控制界面时，我几乎能感觉到指尖传来的金属痕迹。——当然，那其实只是鼠标垫上磨损的橡胶纹理。但我宁愿相信那是调整炮口高低机的转轮，带着某种神圣的阻尼，一圈一圈，把愤怒的弧度拧进膛线里。 这仪式冗长得近乎于

ja.title: 成果だらけの一週間｜Tips 8.8～8.14
ja.summary: 【Ministry Book】は毎週金曜日更新のマシンコア記事エリアのコラムです。毎週金曜日の退社前に、数人の編集者から「ショートエッセイ」を集めます。主題はランダムであり、意図は自分で選択されます。列名は、Windows システムに付属する最もポータブルなテキスト エディターから取られており、「軽さと楽しさ」を表しています。今週登場するキャラクター: Xuedou、Bai Guangda、Samiii Xuedou: 「Iron Nest Heavy Artillery」のプレイに夢中になり、デジタル鋼鉄の要塞に閉じ込められ、存在しない大砲の軌道を繰り返し推測していました。画面上の座標グリッドは蜘蛛の巣のように正確で、それぞれの鱗は数の犠牲を待っています。冷たいコントロール インターフェイス上でマウスを滑らせると、指先から金属の痕跡を感じることができます。 ——もちろん、それは実際にはマウスパッドの摩耗した革の質感です。しかし、私はむしろ、それがある種の神聖な減衰を備えた大砲の高低の機械の車輪であり、怒りの弧を旋回してライフリングにねじ曲げていると信じたいと思います。この儀式は非常に長く、ほとんど修道院のようなものです。

en.title: A week full of achievements｜Tips 8.8～8.14
en.summary: [Ministry Book] is a column in the machine core article area, updated every Friday. Before getting off work every Friday, we will collect "short essays" from several editors. The subject matter is random and the intention is self-selected. The column name is taken from the most portable text editor that comes with the Windows system, which represents "lightness and fun". Characters appearing this week: Xuedou, Bai Guangda, Samiii Xuedou: I was so obsessed with playing "Iron Nest Heavy Artillery" that I locked myself in a digital steel fortress, repeatedly deducing the trajectory of a non-existent artillery. The coordinate grid on the screen is as precise as a spider web, and each scale is waiting for the sacrifice of a number. When the mouse slides over those cold control interfaces, I can almost feel the metal traces coming from my fingertips. ——Of course, that’s actually just the worn leather texture on the mouse pad. But I would rather believe that it is the wheel of the artillery high and low machine, with some kind of sacred damping, twisting the angry arc into the rifling, round and round. This ceremony is so lengthy that it is almost monastic.

items.title: 全新功能“机核FM”现已上线

ja.title: 新機能「Machine Core FM」がオンライン化

en.title: The new function "Machine Core FM" is now online

To put it simply, it is a large-capacity exclusive broadcast list selected and integrated by the machine core operation team. Regular updates: We will change the playlist content every two weeks (half a month). Theme planning: Based on holidays or current popular time nodes, we will launch a limited collection of theme content. Returning to the traditional radio experience In Machine Core FM, we deliberately removed some conventional playback control functions. No Comments Feature: Interface removes reviews of single podcasts

en.title: Research results show that if humans keep watching AI's ``pretending to understand'', humans will no longer be able to say ``I don't understand''
en.summary: Generative AI often doesn't answer "I don't know" when asked, but instead comes up with some random fabrication. We have begun to see the possibility that humans using generative AI are also affected by this, and are no longer able to say, "I don't understand." read more...

items.summary: 針で皮膚に傷を付けてインクを染み込ませるタトゥーは、ファッションや自己表現として広く受け入れられています。また近年は、専用の針で皮膚に色素を埋め込んで眉やアイラインを描く美容目的のアートメイクも盛んです。ところが、アメリカ食品医薬品局(FDA)が259個のタトゥーインクやアートメイク用インク(permanent makeup ink：PMU)を調査したところ、たとえ「滅菌済み」とラベルが貼られているものであっても、約3分の1には細菌が混入していることが判明しました。続きを読む...

zh.title: 大约三分之一的“消毒”纹身和永久化妆品墨水受到细菌污染，包括可能引起感染的病原体。
zh.summary: 纹身是用针在皮肤上切开并用墨水浸泡的纹身，被广泛认为是一种时尚和自我表达的形式。近年来，以美容为目的的永久化妆也开始流行，使用特殊的针将颜料嵌入皮肤并画眉毛和眼线。然而，当美国食品和药物管理局 (FDA) 调查 259 种纹身墨水和永久化妆墨水 (PMU) 时，发现大约三分之一被细菌污染，即使它们被标记为“已灭菌”。 阅读更多...

en.title: Approximately one-third of ``sterilized'' ink for tattoos and permanent makeup is contaminated with bacteria, including pathogens that can cause infections.
en.summary: Tattoos, in which the skin is incised with a needle and soaked with ink, are widely accepted as a form of fashion and self-expression. In recent years, permanent makeup for beauty purposes has also become popular, using special needles to embed pigment into the skin and draw eyebrows and eyeliner. However, when the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) investigated 259 tattoo inks and permanent makeup inks (PMU), it was found that approximately one-third were contaminated with bacteria, even if they were labeled as ``sterilized.'' read more...
